## Problem

On a cold Turborepo cache, `moo-dang` tests fail with:

```
Error: Failed to resolve import "@sparkle/test-utils/dom" from "src/components/Terminal.test.tsx"
Error: Failed to resolve import "@sparkle/test-utils/console" from "src/shell/wasm-integration.test.ts"
```

The `moo-dang` test suite imports from `@sparkle/test-utils` subpath exports (`/dom`, `/console`, `/terminal`) which require the `dist/` directory to be populated. However, the `test` Turbo task only depended on `build:utils`, `build:theme`, `build:config`, and `build:ui` — not on `@sparkle/test-utils#build`.

`@sparkle/test-utils` uses the generic `build` task (not a named `build:test-utils`), so it was not included in the test dependency chain. On a warm cache this is masked; on a cold cache the 6 affected test files fail.

## Fix

Add `@sparkle/test-utils#build` as an explicit dependency in the `test`, `test:coverage`, and `test:watch` Turbo tasks.

## Verification

- `pnpm test` passes: 445 tests, 1 skipped ✅
- `pnpm build` clean: 10/10 tasks ✅
